idle.description: Relaxed standing quadruped: breathing, slow look-around, tail sway, ear flicks.

alert_idle.description: Alert stance: chest and head raised, ears forward, quick head snaps left/right, tail lifted.

walk.description: Diagonal-sequence quadrupedal walk. All four contacts move at the same ground speed (0.37 m/s, 0.8 s per cycle), so there is no foot slide when the root moves at that speed: set timeScale = travelSpeed / 0.37.

scurry.description: Fast bounding run with spine flexion, 0.40 s per cycle. Contact points move at 1.19 m/s: set timeScale = travelSpeed / 1.19.

turn_in_place_L.description: 90 degree pivot to the left with staggered diagonal steps. Root yaw (+90 deg) is baked into the root bone: apply it to the character heading when the clip ends.

turn_in_place_R.description: 90 degree pivot to the right with staggered diagonal steps. Root yaw (-90 deg) is baked into the root bone: apply it to the character heading when the clip ends.

hop.description: Short bounding hop: crouch, launch, flight, hands-first landing. Root travel of 0.20 m forward is baked into the clip.

climb_up.description: Diagonal-couplet climb up a vertical trunk (radius 0.12 m). Contacts slide down the bark at 0.343 m/s: move the root up the trunk at that speed (timeScale = climbSpeed / 0.343).

climb_down.description: Backing down a vertical trunk (feet lead, head up, glancing over the shoulder). Contacts slide up at 0.244 m/s: move the root DOWN at that speed.

climb_hang_idle.description: Resting on the trunk: all four limbs gripping, breathing, tail sway, looking around.

climb_start.description: Ground to trunk: the monkey stands facing the bark with its root 0.52 m from the trunk surface (root y = +0.52, nose 5 cm off the bark), rears up, grabs the trunk, hops its feet up, and lands in the first frame of climb_up (root y = -0.13, z = 0.26).

climb_dismount.description: Trunk to ground: exact time-reverse of climb_start (ends standing 0.36 m from the trunk, facing it).

branch_walk.description: Quadrupedal walk along a ~4 cm horizontal branch (feet/hands in a narrow line, gripping, tail used for balance). Contact speed 0.21 m/s at 1.0 s per cycle. Root origin sits on the top of the branch.

sit_down.description: Standing quadruped to upright sit, hands lifting onto the knees. Ends on the first frame of sit_idle.

stand_up.description: Time-reverse of sit_down: seated to standing quadruped.

sit_idle.description: Seated rest: breathing, slow head scans, fingers flexing on the knees, tail resting on the ground, ear flicks.

groom.description: Self-grooming while seated: left forearm held up, right hand combing and pinching the fur, head bowed, lip-smacking.

look_around.description: Standing observation: slow scan left, up, right and down with the chest following the head, ear swivels and a little weight shift.

scratch.description: Seated, leaning away and raking the flank with the right hind foot (6 strokes per loop) while looking down at it.

investigate.description: Foraging inspection: nose to the ground, sniffing bobs, left hand patting and raking at the surface.

curious.description: Curious reaction: rises on the front limbs, stretches the neck and tilts the head side to side with ears pricked, then settles.

startled.description: Startle: flinch, a jolt backwards 0.10 m (root travel baked in, towards +Y) landing in a low alert crouch with ears flat, mouth open and tail whipped up.

threat_display.description: Threat display: low forward crouch, ears flat, mouth open in a gape, jerky head bobs, and a hand slap on the ground (once per loop).

social_greet.description: Friendly greeting while seated: head bobs, rapid lip-smacking jaw chatter, ears forward, relaxed hands.

pose_crouch.description: Low alert crouch, ready to dart or pounce.

pose_present.description: Rear presented to a partner, head turned back, tail raised (social presenting).

pose_threat.description: Frozen threat posture: crouched, ears flat, mouth gaping.

pose_sit.description: Upright seated posture, hands on knees.

coconut_approach.description: Low stalking walk towards a coconut: crouched, head forward, ears pricked, tail low and still. 0.21 m/s at 1.0 s per cycle.

coconut_reach.coconut_start: ground, 0.56 m ahead of the root (P(0,0.56,0.062))
coconut_reach.description: Steps in from standing and reaches for a coconut resting 0.56 m ahead: left hand tests the top, then both hands close around it. The coconut stays on the ground (coconut_attach is keyed at its resting place).

coconut_grab_lift.description: Both hands tighten on the coconut, drag it in and haul it up as the monkey sits back onto its haunches; ends holding the coconut at the chest (first frame of coconut_hold_idle).

coconut_hold_idle.description: Seated, cradling the coconut at the chest: slow turning of the nut in the hands, sniffing, glances around.

coconut_inspect.description: Holds the coconut up in front of the face and rotates it through a full turn (hands re-grip), sniffing and head-bobbing.

coconut_guard.description: Possessive guarding: hunched over the coconut hugged to the belly, shoulders rolled in, fast suspicious head scans, ears flat, jaw twitching.

coconut_tug_holder.description: Tug of war (holder). Place the partner monkey 1.08 m in front (A.position + A.forward * 1.08) rotated 180 degrees and play both loops together: the coconut is at the same world position in both clips every frame (bone coconut_attach on either monkey).

coconut_tug_challenger.description: Tug of war (challenger). Place the partner monkey 1.08 m in front (A.position + A.forward * 1.08) rotated 180 degrees and play both loops together: the coconut is at the same world position in both clips every frame (bone coconut_attach on either monkey).

coconut_triumph.description: Triumph: sits tall, thrusts the coconut overhead with a whooping gape and a head-back shake, then lowers it to the chest (ends on coconut_hold_idle frame 0).

coconut_lose.description: Loses the coconut: yanked forward, hands pried open, coconut leaves (ends 0.30 m in front), monkey slumps, ears flat, head low.

coconut_carry_walk.description: Tripod walk carrying the coconut pressed to the chest with the left arm. Contact speed 0.28 m/s at 0.8 s per cycle.

pose_coconut_hold.description: Seated, holding the coconut at the chest.
